First check the employment contract and give the required notice (or pay in lieu)


The Employment Act requires either party to give notice to end employment; minimum notice depends on length of service (e.g. 1 day for <26 weeks, 1 week for 26 weeks–2 years, 2 weeks for 2–5 years, 4 weeks for 5+ years). The contract may set a different period but it must be the same for employer and employee. (Employment Act s.10)
